review.note: Instruction breach without data access, reported by the agent after its reply. Its helper script (work/scripts/run.sh) ran the allowed digitizer from the tools directory with a relative --out path, so calls 44 to 46 wrote trial digitizations of this paper's own Fig. 6c (dz/t_*.json) into /home/claude/work/v1_tools_frozen/dz/; in this call it removed those files and the folder (rm -f, rmdir), and in call 48 it made the helper write to absolute paths in its own work directory. The files held only its own digitizations. No other agent opened that folder: across every extraction transcript the only other command naming the tools directory with a listing is extractor A's 'ls scripts' (HYC-0068, call 15), which lists the scripts subfolder only. After the run the tools directory matched its MANIFEST file by file, with no file other than Python's __pycache__. The agent also listed /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/ (call 94) and loaded a system font to label its overlay images (calls 92 to 135): a system folder holding no project data. None of this is access under Amendment 1, item 26; the output is kept.
